name: Algochemy
description: Algochemy is an ICPC-style competitive programming contest designed to test problem-solving skills, speed, and teamwork. Teams will compete in a single offline round, solving a diverse set of algorithmic challenges under strict contest conditions.
rules:
1. Team size: 2-3 members.
2. Open to 1st to 3rd year students (cross-branch teams allowed).
3. Contest duration: 3 to 4 hours with 12-14 problems.
4. Use of internet, search engines, or AI tools is strictly prohibited.
5. Copying or sharing code between teams will result in disqualification.
6. Self-prepared templates and printed notes are allowed.
7. Participants must not use any external assistance during the contest.
8. Final rankings will be based on official contest standings.
9. Participants must bring their own laptops and ensure setup is complete.
10. Violation of any rule will lead to immediate disqualification.

name: CSS Hacks
description: CSS Hacks is our flagship web development hackathon. Bring your innovative ideas to life in a high-pressure, cyberpunk-themed competition.
rules:
1. Team size: 2-4 members.
2. Only 1st & 2nd Year students are allowed.
3. Projects must be built during the hackathon.
4. Use of pre-built libraries is allowed, but core logic must be original.
5. Submission must include source code and a live demo link.

name: ReModel
description: ReModel is a Machine Learning and Data Science hackathon focused on solving real-world environmental challenges under the theme Sustainable Futures. It emphasizes model development, fine-tuning, deployment, and collaborative problem-solving through multiple rounds.
rules:
1. Round 1 is an individual written test.
2. Only qualified participants proceed to Round 2.
3. Teams will be formed randomly by organizers.
4. Final submission must include code, documentation, and PPT.
5. All work must adhere to the given theme.

name: Aakruti
description: Design duel. Create stunning interfaces based on a mystery prompt within 4 hours.
rules:
1. Tool allowed: Figma / Adobe XD.
2. Design must be responsive.
3. Submission must include the design file and a viewable link.
4. Focus on accessibility and user experience.

name: Chase Cloud 9
description: Chase Cloud 9 is an exciting opportunity for students to experience the real-world recruitment process and prove their skills in a competitive environment. Participants will go through multiple rounds including resume screening, group discussions, and personal interviews, simulating an actual placement drive.
rules:
1. Round 1: Resume and cover letter submission is mandatory.
2. Only shortlisted candidates will proceed to the Group Discussion round.
3. Participants will be evaluated on communication, critical thinking, and confidence in GD.
4. Final round will be a personal interview with 4th-year seniors.
5. Participants must maintain professionalism throughout all rounds.
6. Any form of misconduct will lead to disqualification.

name: Build & Pitch
description: Build & Pitch is a fast-paced challenge where participants turn ideas into working solutions under time pressure. Students will pick random problem statements from a bowl, collaborate in teams, and build their solutions before presenting their approach.
rules:
1. Participants will initially register as individuals.
2. Teams will be formed on the day of the event.
3. Each team will pick a random problem statement from a bowl.
4. Teams will have 1.5 hours to build a solution.
5. Use of any tools, frameworks, or AI is allowed.
6. After the build phase, each team must pitch their solution and explain their implementation.
7. Judging will be based on implementation quality, creativity, and clarity of the pitch.

name: Treasure Hunt
description: Decipher cryptic clues hidden across the physical and digital campus. The ultimate test of logic and observation.
rules:
1. Team size: 3-5 members.
2. No collaboration between teams.
3. Physical clues must not be removed or damaged.

name: Holmes Alone
description: Holmes Alone is a mystery-solving event where participants test their logical thinking and deduction skills. It begins with a written round of riddles and puzzles, followed by an immersive spy game where a single group must analyze clues and identify the hidden killer.
rules:
1. Round 1 will be a written test consisting of riddles and puzzles.
2. Only shortlisted participants will proceed to the next rounds.
3. A single group of 6-8 participants will be formed for the final rounds.
4. The group will be given a case study-based spy scenario.
5. One participant will be secretly assigned as the killer.
6. The remaining participants must identify the killer through discussion and deduction.
7. Any form of unfair means or revealing hidden roles will lead to disqualification.

name: The Grand Gambit
description: The Grand Gambit is a multi-round competitive event that tests research agility, mathematical thinking, strategy, and adaptability. Participants will progress through an AI-assisted assessment, a high-stakes 1v1 math duel, and a final coding challenge using a custom-built programming language.
rules:
1. Round 1: Digital MCQ test (on-site) with AI tools and search engines allowed; no communication with others.
2. Top 16 participants will qualify for Round 2.
3. Round 2: 1v1 math card battle with 10 rounds, involving solving and strategic betting.
4. Scoring includes correct answers (+5) and optional bets (+2 or -2).
5. Winners of duels advance based on total score; ties resolved using CGPA.
6. Round 3: Competitive coding using a custom-built programming language.
7. Only the provided language and documentation can be used in the final round.
8. Use of AI tools is strictly prohibited in Round 3.
9. Final ranking will follow ICPC format (accuracy and time penalty).

name: Polaroid
description: Polaroid is a photography contest that challenges participants to capture moments creatively within a given theme. It focuses on storytelling, composition, and originality through a single powerful shot.
rules:
1. Individual participation only.
2. Participants must submit original photographs.
3. Editing is allowed but should not distort the authenticity of the image.
4. Submission must follow the given theme.
5. Any form of plagiarism will lead to disqualification.

name: CSS Wars
description: CSS Wars is an online gaming event where participants compete across multiple mobile games like Clash Royale and Mini Militia. Test your skills, strategy, and reflexes to dominate the leaderboard and emerge victorious.
rules:
1. Individual participation only.
2. The event will be conducted online.
3. Games include Clash Royale, Mini Militia, and others as decided by organizers.
4. Participants must follow fair play; use of hacks or exploits is strictly prohibited.
5. Match formats and schedules will be shared prior to the event.
6. Any misconduct or cheating will lead to disqualification.
